server.name: io.github.prest/prest
server.description: Stdio MCP adapter bridging AI clients to pREST’s HTTP /_mcp endpoint for PostgreSQL APIs.
server.title: pREST

environmentVariables.description: URL of your running pREST HTTP MCP endpoint, for example http://localhost:3000/_mcp
environmentVariables.name: PREST_MCP_URL

environmentVariables.description: Optional bearer token used to authenticate with the pREST MCP endpoint.
environmentVariables.name: PREST_MCP_TOKEN

environmentVariables.description: Optional HTTP timeout in milliseconds. Defaults to 30000.
environmentVariables.name: PREST_MCP_TIMEOUT_MS
